breach on the part of the other shall serve upon the other written notice (or oral notice in an
emergency), specifying with particularity where in said default or breach is alleged to exist, and
the other party shall fail to perform or observe said covenant or condition, or otherwise fail to
remedy and cure said default orbreach, within the time specified in Section45, or the case of the
Landlord default within ten (10) days after service upon such party of said notice.
50.LANDLORD'S LIEN.In the event Tenant is in default of this Lease, Landlord may hold
all of Tenant's merchandise, trade fixtures and other personal property in the Premises assecurity
for the payments of rents and other amounts due and thereafter becoming due during the remainder
of the term of this Lease. Landlord may remove such property from the Premises and store it in a
public warehouse or elsewhere at Tenant'sexpense.
51.SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant shall pay to Landlord at the time of the execution of this
Lease a deposit of Two Thousand Six Hundred Twenty-Five Dollars ($6,225.00)which shall be
retained by Landlord as security for thefull and faithful performance of every provision of this
Lease to be performed by Tenant.The deposit may be used to cure any failure of the Tenant to
repair or clean the Premises, or to pay rent, or any other default.Within thirty (30) days after the
expiration of the term of this Lease, any unused portion of thisfund will be returned to the Tenant.
No interest shall accrue on this deposit.Landlord shall not be obligated tokeep this deposit in a
segregated account.
52.ACCESS BY LANDLORD.Landlord or Landlord's agent shall have the right to enter the
Premises at all reasonable times to examine the Premises or to show the Premises to prospective
purchasers or mortgagees, and to make such repairs, as Landlord may deem necessary or desirable,
and Landlord shallbe allowed to take all material into and upon the Premises that maybe required
without the same constituting an eviction of Tenant in whole or in part, and the rent reserved shall
in noway abate while saidrepairs, examinations or showings arebeing made, byreason ofloss of
business of Tenant, or otherwise.During the six(6) months prior to the expiration of the Primary
Term, as applicable, or at any time Tenant is in default, Landlord may exhibit the Premises to
notices Tenants hall permit to remain there on without molestation.
53.ABANDONMENT. If Tenant should violate this prohibition, or be dispossessed of the
Premises involuntarily, by operation of law or otherwise, any personal property belonging to
Tenant andleft on the Premises shallbe deemed tobe abandoned, at Landlord's option, or Landlord
may store such property in Tenant's name and at Tenant's expense, without notice to Tenant.

54.SURRENDER AND HOLDOVER. On the last day or sooner termination of this Lease,
Tenant shall quit and surrender the Premises, broom clean, in good condition and repair
(reasonable wear and tear and damage by acts of God or other cause beyond Tenant's reasonable
control excepted)together with all alterations, additions and improvements which may have been
made in, to or on the Premises, except movable furniture and movable trade fixtures put in at the
from the Premises and all property not so removed shall be deemed abandoned by Tenant. If the
Premises are not surrendered at theend of the Lease term, Tenant shall indemnify Landlord against
loss or liability resulting from delay by Tenant inso surrendering the Premises including, without
limitation, any claims made by any succeeding tenant founded on such delay, and shall pay rent
equal to double the amount of thelast scheduled monthly rent, which shall be proratedfor each
day that Tenantfails to surrender possession of the Premises to Landlord.

at that time and in payment of any and all expenses incurred by Landlord incident to the removal
andsale of such abandoned property.

Landlord's consent or approval shall not be deemed towaive or render unnecessary Landlord's or

subsequent acceptance of rent hereunder by Landlord shall not constitute awaiverof any preceding
breach by Tenant of any term, covenant or condition of this Lease, other than the failure of Tenant
to pay the particular rental so accepted, regardless of Landlord's knowledge of such preceding
breach at the time or acceptance of such rent. No waiver shall be effective unless it is in writing
and signed by Landlord.

permitted by the terms of this Lease may be given by or to any one thereof, and shall have the
